sections.Guaranteed to blow your mind:
The greatest rock band in history has finally entered the pinball scene! Now, you can experience their legendary live performances from your own home, with Hi-Fi sound so good it almost feels like you’re part of the crowd. To make good things even better, the Queen band members have recorded call-outs exclusively for your game experience.
This music-video game takes you along with two magnificent live performances – Budapest 1986 and Montreal 1987 – where Freddie Mercury’s captivating showmanship comes alive, and Brian May’s Red Special Guitar offers a playfield of its own.
Each of the 14 acts is closely tied to the action on the game field, so you need to complete every song to max out your points. Drop by Wembley Stadium to start one of many multiball modes. Collect tour passes, posters, instruments, and albums. Get them signed for a collector’s jackpot. Keep on fighting until the final wizard mode, “I Want It All,” where you can finally become the champion.
The Rhapsody Edition is limited to 1,000 numbered units. Featuring numerous add-ons and an eye-catching design, each Rhapsody Edition game comes with a certificate of authenticity.
sections.Specs:
- Red Special Upper Playfield with Full Size Flipper
